description: This file contains functions and classes for customizing and formatting tensor string representations in PyTorch, including print options, tensor type conversions, and detailed tensor string serialization logic.

classes.name: __PrinterOptions
classes.description: Dataclass holding configuration options for tensor printing, such as precision, threshold, edge items, line width, and scientific mode.

classes.name: _Formatter
classes.description: Class responsible for formatting tensor values into strings, handling floating point, integer, and complex types, and supporting scientific notation and width calculations.

methods.name: set_printoptions
methods.description: Configures global print options for tensors, including precision, threshold, edge items, linewidth, profile, and scientific mode.

methods.name: get_printoptions
methods.description: Returns current tensor print options as a dictionary.

methods.name: printoptions
methods.description: Context manager to temporarily set tensor print options within a code block.

methods.name: tensor_totype
methods.description: Converts a tensor to a specified dtype based on device and type properties.

methods.name: get_summarized_data
methods.description: Returns a summarized version of a tensor for display, truncating large tensors.
